provenance.construction: Multi-band dense-packed surface code (generalization of the two-band packing of arXiv:2511.06758, builder research/multiband_surface.py build): square surface-code patches of size d=5 in 7 horizontal bands at pitch 6, 8 patches per even band and 7 per odd band, odd bands half-pitch staggered so neighbouring patches share boundary infrastructure and the packing is one connected code rather than a direct sum. Parameters (d, rows, m, pitch) = (5, 7, 8, 6), at the measured pitch floor 2*floor(3d/4) = 6, where k unlocks together with the design distance. Measured n=989, k=53 by exact GF(2) rank, max check weight 4, one connected component.
provenance.notes: Reference: arXiv:2511.06758 (two-band dense packing, Fujiu et al.).

search_budget.notes: 62 configurations built and exactly ranked; 14 Pareto-undominated in the cell at n<=1000, each measured at 300k RIS trials/side; 2M trials/side on the submitted code.
